**Subject: Resignation – [Your Full Name]**  

Dear [Supervisor’s Name],

I am writing to formally resign from my position as a Project Assistant at [Company Name], effective [last working day – typically two weeks from the date of this letter, e.g., 28 days from today’s date].

I have given considerable thought to this decision, and, after much reflection, I have decided to resign to pursue a new personal venture abroad. This is not a decision I have taken lightly, given the experiences and professional growth I have gained during my 14 months at [Company Name].

I want to express my gratitude for the opportunities I have had to learn, collaborate, and develop within the team. I have especially valued the supportive atmosphere and the practical experience I have gained working alongside the engineering professionals here.

I am committed to ensuring a smooth transition during my notice period. Please let me know how best I can assist in handing over my responsibilities, documenting current projects, or training any colleagues who may handle my tasks in the future.

I understand the potential impact of my departure and want to assure you that I will do everything in my power to minimize disruption and support the team through this change.

Once again, thank you for the support and opportunities you have provided me. If there is anything additional I can do prior to my departure, please do not hesitate to reach out.

Sincerely,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Contact Information, if preferred]  

---  
*Note: Replace the bracketed items (e.g., [Supervisor’s Name], [last working day], etc.) with your specific details. Also, keep a copy for your records.*
